summary.text: Magic 2013 gathers short tales from across the multiverse, from Odric trapping a creature near Torbach that turns out to be the cursed Garruk Wildspeaker, to Sentos facing a gorgon of Xathrid who demands a ring that grants ceaseless life.
Krenko is hired by Mr. Taz for a heist at Sunhome, and Talrand calls down drakes on the dragon Kalyntri, ending his rule.
In the last tale, Nira gives Lia the warrior name Kaa-lia and the two destroy a keystone, but the demon escapes and Kaalia vows revenge.
